name: native-index-memory
goal: Bound source indexing memory while preserving complete revision data and resource admission safeguards

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: On hosted macOS verification timed out at 1721 MiB available below the 2048 MiB reserve; local full-revision indexing retains 1.7 GB RSS and bounded 256-read experiment retains 1.0 GB with equal output counts.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard unit-index source tests cover metadata and HTTP dependencies with small synchronous trees but never exercise many pending reads, their order, completion or rejection. Extend that matrix through SourceIndexService.index with a delayed SourceTree.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed source-index test failed because 300 reads ran at once; regression record 0eaa38c1 retains the assertion and measured workload.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: SourceIndexService admits at most 256 reads and releases each slot on success or failure while preserving Promise.all result order.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged regression passed at 3a53e0d; record 4f79ab6d pairs it with red 0eaa38c1 under the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
